sampling: SHA-256(cell_id), first 32 bits modulo 8 == 0; deterministic approximately 1/8 sample. Counts use all labeled registered cells, not sampled points.

coordinate_frame.note: Same PIR axes and RAS origin verified against the official ABC annotation_25 and the existing anatomical template. Source cell coordinates are retained; no mirroring or interpolation.

registration_audit.note: Independent nearest-voxel check on every 100th labeled registered cell. Mismatches are retained with the source parcellation assignment. This diagnostic is not a claim of exact boundary or cell-level anatomical accuracy.

limitations: One adult wild-type male mouse; not human, developmental, or autism-specific data.
Cell-type labels are transferred from a transcriptomic taxonomy, not directly observed cell functions.
Only cells in supplied metadata with CCF coordinates and a known non-background region are included. Coverage can be unilateral and uneven.
Points are a deterministic display sample of cell centers, not cell shapes or an exhaustive cell census.
Regional counts describe the supplied registered dataset; they are not stereological population estimates or physical density.
Colors are categories, not gene expression. Existing ISH expression comes from separate specimens and experiments.
